scope: Independent raw arithmetic and admission records; existing native semantic oracles checked, not fully reimplemented. No products/tests/builds run.
method_limits: 100Hz self CPU has 10ms ticks; complete CPU includes startup/driver/verification/close, while measured-turn CPU uses the explicit prior sample or after_initialization.
Memory is maximum of sampled Pss_Anon, not continuous peak; process write_bytes is not device write traffic.
Confirmation cases were selected after initial adverse observations. Report both cohorts separately; no sample exclusion or pooled median to hide initial results.
Pairwise log t intervals are exploratory estimates under independence/shape assumptions, not familywise tests or proof of universal nonregression.
